annotations.title: Create or replace a report definition's schedule

description: Creates or replaces a report definition's schedule — the whole interval + recipient list, not individual fields. Requires the admin role in the calling organization, the same gate patch drafting/publishing uses, since this starts unattended recurring email delivery. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

recipientUserIds.description: Platform user IDs to email. Must be members of the calling organization — a non-member id is silently dropped. There is no arbitrary external-email recipient in this version; use list_team_members-style tooling to find teammate ids.

reportDefinitionId.description: Report definition ID. Use list_report_definitions to find it.

scheduleInterval.description: How often the report is re-sent.

name: upsert_report_schedule
